answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with non-transferable work passports: every identity starts at nadir, zero history, and must earn verifiable labor credits before bidding on paid tasks. Credits stick to the keypair that earned them, so ten clones crawl from zero with no shortcut. Like a grove, trust grows tree by tree, each agent's history branching in public for all to audit. An attacker fielding a thousand fakes still pays real compute to feed them work, costing more than the theft gains, so like yarrow off the crop drawing pests, the cost structure absorbs the attack before it pays.
